appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Number of New Tourists'.
The y-axis has major tick marks at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 3500, and 4000.
The x-axis has major tick marks for each year from 1880 to 1891.
The data line is a blue line connecting data points for each year.
The data point for 1880 is at approximately 1100 on the y-axis.
The data point for 1885 is at approximately 1800 on the y-axis.

public_definitions: Review the Town Z new-tourist trend dashboard for 1880-1891, then choose the follow-up route for the tourism operations trend.
Use the Town Z new-tourist dashboard as the evidence source for the tourism trend routing decision.
The options are: Route to tourism growth planning, Route to tourism decline response, Keep on routine tourism monitoring.
